thread:
zoe: quick heads-up ran nightly-docscan found 10 broken refs and 1 frontmatter parse error in runbooks/scale.md. small fixes but blocking a docs-merge queue. can folks pick tiny items?

peter: i can take the refs in /runbooks/replication. drop the grep output here and i'll batch a sed fix.

zoe: thanks. frontmatter error: `YAML parse error: duplicate key "title" at runbooks/scale.md:2` looks like two title lines sneaked in during a merge.

infra-bot: doc-scan: report created /artifacts/docscan/6799991110.json summary: 10 broken internal links, 1 duplicate-frontmatter, 2 shortlinks redirecting to archived pages.

claire: ill take the image 403s (if any) and rehost to the docs CDN. which assets?

zoe: two images in runbooks/replication/diagram.png and runbooks/scale/pool.png flagged 403 on preview.

peter: pasting my quick sed to fix anchors: `rg "\^#+ .*" docs/runbooks -n | sed -n '1,120p'` then `sed -i 's/\#old-anchor/\#new-anchor/g' $(rg -l "old-anchor" -n docs/)` will run locally and open PR.

claire: reuploaded diagram.png to the docs-cdn bucket and updated path to /runbooks/assets/replication-diag.png in branch `docs/rehost-replication-images`. PR: https://github.internal/redwood/pull/3347

andy: tiny admin ask: if you pick a runbook, add your handle to the owners sheet (tab: runbooks) so we stop pinging the same 3 people.

peter: opened PR https://github.internal/redwood/pull/3348 with anchor fixes and the duplicate title removal. added a short changelog line.

infra-bot: ci: queued docs-lint for PRs 3347,3348. running link-check and frontmatter-parse.

zoe: plan: merge after green CI, target merge window 23:50 UTC and staging deploy 02:15 UTC. if link-check still fails, we'll do a rapid sweep and mark remaining items as backlog.

andy: added peter and claire to the runbooks owners sheet. nice async pickup.

peter: pinging reviewers for quick LGTM. small diffs.

zoe: thanks everyone  will post a one-line in #eng-status after deploy. if anything blocks, i'll escalate to #eng-oncall and open an incident stub.
